$description: Synaptiq, from synaptiq.ai and the Synaptiq Design System (brand guide v1.1). Light is the brand as published: white ground, Soil text, Jasper links and calls to action, Arctic and Apricot Ink as supporting colours. Synaptiq defines no dark mode; the dark appearance is derived here (Soil grounds, Apricot Ink as the accent) and should be reviewed by the brand owner. Operator-approved 2026-10-06: the derived dark appearance, the darkened Grapefruit 'limited' state, and Google font stand-ins for the licensed faces.
name: synaptiq
title: Synaptiq
